name: Validation gallery 06: POD + operator inference, advection
description: Periodic advection-diffusion of a tracer: POD + linear operator inference with the full basis and with the basis cut at 95 % of the energy, rolled out against the exact solution (mass conserved) through pp.validate; rollout.spectrum must catch the smeared small scales (examples/validation/06_opinf_weather_advection.py; smoke and full sizes are the same).
